item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00254","decision":"none","candidate_ranking":["C20","C04","C06"],"selected_candidate_label":null,"confidence":0.96,"relationship_type":"none","rationale":"No displayed candidate plausibly supplied a concrete and material drafting template for the child. C20 and C04 contain continuity clauses for existing regulations, but those are routine transitional administrative provisions and differ from the child's ratification of regulations under an amended entry-control proclamation. C06 concerns aliens and departure permits, but its selective-service rules use different legal authority, agencies, purposes, and operative machinery; the topical overlap is insufficient.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"All existing regulations promulgated under or pursuant to the said [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] are hereby ratified and confirmed","parent_excerpt":"all orders, regulations, rulings, instructions, or licenses ... shall continue in full force and effect except as amended, modified, or revoked by the Attorney General","explanation":"C20 has the closest continuity mechanism, but continuation of existing rules during an administrative transition is routine and not materially parallel to ratification following amendment of an entry-control proclamation."},{"child_excerpt":"nothing contained herein shall be deemed to limit lawful authority to amend or modify such regulations","parent_excerpt":"Existing rules and regulations ... shall remain in effect until superseded by action taken pursuant to this order","explanation":"C04 similarly preserves existing regulations while allowing later replacement, but this generic savings mechanism does not establish a reusable drafting relationship."},{"child_excerpt":"no alien shall enter or attempt to enter the United States unless he is in possession of a valid unexpired permit to enter","parent_excerpt":"Local boards are authorized to issue to a registrant a Permit ... to Depart from the United States","explanation":"C06 shares references to aliens and travel permits, but the permit regulates selective-service obligations and departure rather than national-interest screening for admission."}]}
